label: Orders
caption: ROSEN, ACTING ATT’Y GEN., ET AL. V. MONTGOMERY, LISA M.
text: The application for stay or vacatur presented to The Chief Justice and by him referred to the Court is granted. The January 11, 2021 order of the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit granting a stay is vacated. Justice Breyer, Justice Sotomayor, and Justice Kagan would deny the application.
